<!-- tiny-village-roadmap:v1:H3:start -->
## Ordered delivery task H3

A human maintainer decides whether the phase satisfies its acceptance criteria and may unlock the next phase.

- Phase: 3 - Consolidate backlog and pull requests
- Sequence: 3900
- Priority: P1
- Scope: MVP
- Workstream: Review
- Kind: Phase gate
- Parent phase: [E3](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/733)

### Prerequisites

- [P3-01](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/734)
- [P3-02](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/735)
- [P3-03](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/736)
- [P3-04](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/737)
- [H2](https://github.com/dhar174/tiny_village/issues/732)

The preceding phase gate must be human-approved. Dependency closure alone does not supply a human decision.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Review every required task, current PR head, commands/results, and the phase-specific evidence.
- [ ] Walk through the supported behavior, failure cases, and applicable design/engineering artifacts.
- [ ] Choose exactly Approved, Changes requested, or Deferred; record reviewer, date, rationale, evidence, and issue-backed remediation.
- [ ] Only close this gate after a human records Approved; keep rework/deferred gates open and downstream work blocked.
- [ ] Do not auto-approve based on a passing suite, a bot action, elapsed time, or a completed checklist.

### Human decision step-through

- [ ] Human reviewer: dhar174, or a maintainer explicitly delegated in the Project.
- [ ] Check prerequisite issues and the previous phase's recorded decision.
- [ ] Review artifacts, current commit/PR heads, executed checks, known failures, and proposed scope.
- [ ] Walk through the phase's success/failure scenarios and relevant design/engineering evidence.
- [ ] Record reviewer, date, evidence links, rationale, and exactly one decision: Approved / Changes requested / Deferred.
- [ ] Create a separate issue for each required remediation and add it as a blocker.
- [ ] Set Project Decision to the human's recorded decision. Close this issue only after Approved.

Automation must not set Approved, infer approval from silence, or advance a downstream phase on elapsed time.

### Evidence to retain

Current commit/PR SHA; exact commands and executed result counts; relevant state traces/screens; review artifacts; limitations; linked follow-up issues.

<!-- tiny-village-roadmap:v1:H3:end -->
